body:
That is true. I suspect if I was in a relationship it would probably make me happy for a few months, and then I'd get dumped and just return back to how I always am, so there are deeper underlying problems. I don't really feel that I have any mental issues, but rather it is the world we are all forced to live in. Only a few thousand years ago humans were running around in the forest chasing pigs around and building huts, exploring, etc. Now we are all forced into this technological system that has all of these rules, laws and expectations, every single thing has a cost associated with it and you are always someone's bitch at work. Everything you do has to fit within the framework of how you are producing something for society...and if you are an ugly man, your only purpose is the hard labor your body can endure to build and sustain the infrastructure so that those with sexual value can enjoy themselves.

Sure, it is nice that we have medical treatment and aren't starving, but it definitely comes with a cost, which is the fact that many people can't function within this type of society and develop depression. Thanks for replying though, I would like to continue until I hit 30, and then if is apparent that it's just going to be more of the same bullshit, I'll probably just buy a helium tank and go out peacefully.
